issues.description: Successive direct-call support overlays are revision-bound. If one design has control nets with multiple distinct C source subjects, an earlier subject's copied support does not count for the final revision. The audit labels earlier attempts SUPERSEDED and LVS remains UNKNOWN rather than promoting stale support.
issues.release_impact: The bounded single-source direct-call closure passes. General multi-subject batching is future work; this release makes no whole-flow support claim.
